goal: Diseña la primera ola de trabajo para FA-MA
objective: Create a governance lens, enumerate boundaries, and frame the packet wave order.
scope_summary: Global preflight packet. No direct file edits. Shapes the rest of the wave.
acceptance_gates: Summarize the repo objective and boundaries in <= 10 bullets.
Name the top 5 packages by expected relevance to the goal.
List red flags and hard constraints before code changes happen.
constraints: Do not dump whole large files; summarize and cite targeted slices.
Prefer small, composable changes that can be merged independently.
Respect repo conventions and monorepo entrypoint reality.
Output must be useful even if the next packet runs on a smaller model.
risk_notes: This packet should shape, not overfit, the rest of the run.
